# Contributing to living-docs

Thanks for helping.
Small, focused pull requests are the easiest to review.

## Before you start

- Search existing issues and pull requests first.
- For a large change, open an issue to discuss it before writing code.
- Read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) for repository rules and [ARCHITECTURE.md](../ARCHITECTURE.md) for module boundaries.

## Making a change

1. Fork the repository and create a branch from the default branch.
2. Make your change, and add or update tests when behavior changes.
3. Run the checks described in the README and make sure they pass.
4. Open a pull request that explains what changed and why.

## Commit messages

Use Conventional Commits, for example `fix: handle empty input` or `feat: add a dry run flag`.

## Conduct and security

Everyone taking part is expected to follow the [Code of Conduct](https://github.com/bytesbybrandon/living-docs/blob/HEAD/.github/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
Report vulnerabilities privately, as described in the [security policy](SECURITY.md), and not in a public issue.
